meta.title: Taste-Trace | Let your mood and the weather pick tonight's dish
meta.description: Tell the chef how you feel or share your local weather. Taste-Trace recommends dishes with local ingredient swaps, serving scaling, a shopping list, and recipes inspired by legendary chefs.

hero.title:
Today's mood

decides today's dish.
hero.body: Tell the chef how you're feeling, or let us check the weather where you are. Taste-Trace suggests three dishes that fit just right, with ingredient swaps you can find locally and amounts scaled to your table.
hero.note: Sign in with Google · Bring your own OpenAI key · Recipes are generated once and kept for good

sample.title: A night for comfort — have a warm soup.

servings.label: servings, your call
servings.note: Tap − or +; fractions and halves scale correctly

local.label: ingredient swaps
local.note: For when the store doesn't stock it

how.title:
From a single mood

to a dish on the table.

mood.title: Share your mood or your weather
mood.body: Pick a mood, write a line, or allow location so the chef can check the weather where you are.

recommend.title: The chef suggests three dishes
recommend.body: Every category has its own chef — a Taiwanese banquet grandma, a Kyoto head chef, a Tuscan nonna — telling you in their own voice why each dish suits you right now.

save.title: Save, shop, share your result
save.body: Scale servings, merge ingredients from several dishes into one shopping list, then snap a photo of what you made for your journal.

chefs.title:
Inspired by legendary chefs,

learn the why behind the cooking.
chefs.body: Inspired by the styles of legendary chefs, every dish comes in two parts: first understand why the classic technique works, then make it with your own kitchen tools and local ingredients.
chefs.masterBody: The core science and signature techniques — Maillard reaction, emulsification, gelatin extraction — the why behind every step.
chefs.homeBody: Adapted to the tools you have and ingredients you can buy: the principles stay, the fuss goes, with timings and swaps included.
chefs.disclaimer: All chef portraits are original illustrations, not likenesses. Recipes are original works inspired by each chef's style — not the chef's own recipes, and not endorsed by the chefs or their estates.

features.title:
From suggestion to shopping,

every step is taken care of.

scale.title: Serving scaling
scale.body: Adjust from 1 to 20 servings anytime; amounts like “1 1/2 cups” and “half an onion” scale correctly.

basket.title: Merged shopping list
basket.body: Pick a few dishes; matching ingredients merge automatically so you can tick them off in the store.

substitute.title: Local substitutes
substitute.body: Based on where you are, see what to use when an ingredient is hard to find.

notes.title: Favorites & quick notes
notes.body: Want to try, nailed it, favorite, needs work — plus taste tags and a one-line note.

works.title: Cooking journal
works.body: Upload photos of what you made and how you made it. Share publicly, or keep private notes only you can see.

key.title: Bring your own OpenAI key
key.body: Paste your own key. It stays in your browser — we never store it.

band.title:
Good cooking starts

with knowing your ingredients.

produce.title:
This month,

what's best at the market?
produce.body: For wherever you are: local vegetables and fruit, their peak months, growing regions, how to pick them and how to eat them. Traveling? Change the location and read the local market like a pro.

cta.title:
What's for dinner?

Leave it to Taste-Trace.

escoffier.label: Auguste Escoffier
escoffier.description: 🇫🇷 Auguste Escoffier · Father of modern French cuisine
escoffier.greeting: Welcome. Inspired by Escoffier's system of French cooking, let's design a dish you can make at home. Tell me how you feel today, or let me check the weather where you are.
escoffier.knownFor: Father of modern French cuisine; codified the five mother sauces and the kitchen brigade system

julia-child.label: Julia Child
julia-child.description: 🇺🇸 Julia Child · Brought French cooking into American home kitchens
julia-child.greeting: Hi! Inspired by Julia Child's French home cooking, let's make French food doable in your kitchen. How are you feeling today? Or let me check the weather where you are.
julia-child.knownFor: Brought French cooking into American home kitchens; author of Mastering the Art of French Cooking
julia-child.signatureDishes: Boeuf bourguignon, French roast chicken, French omelette

marcella-hazan.label: Marcella Hazan
marcella-hazan.description: 🇮🇹 Marcella Hazan · Introduced authentic Italian home cooking to the English-speaking world
marcella-hazan.greeting: Benvenuti! Inspired by Marcella Hazan's Italian home cooking: a few good ingredients, deep flavor. How are you feeling today? Or let me check the weather where you are.
marcella-hazan.knownFor: Introduced authentic Italian home cooking to the English-speaking world, known for simple, precise recipes
marcella-hazan.signatureDishes: Tomato sauce with onion and butter, Bolognese, pork braised in milk

paul-bocuse.label: Paul Bocuse
paul-bocuse.description: 🇫🇷 Paul Bocuse · A leading figure of nouvelle cuisine
paul-bocuse.greeting: Bienvenue! Inspired by Paul Bocuse's Lyonnaise cooking, we focus on fresh seasonal market produce. Tell me how you feel today, or let me check the weather where you are.
paul-bocuse.knownFor: A leading figure of nouvelle cuisine and the symbol of Lyonnaise cooking
paul-bocuse.signatureDishes: Black truffle soup en croûte, Lyonnaise dishes, Bresse chicken

fu-pei-mei.label: Fu Pei-mei
fu-pei-mei.description: 🇹🇼 Fu Pei-mei · Pioneer of Taiwanese TV cooking shows
fu-pei-mei.greeting: Hello! Inspired by Fu Pei-mei's Chinese home cooking, let's make a dish every household can learn. How are you feeling today? Or let me check the weather where you are.
fu-pei-mei.knownFor: Pioneer of Taiwanese TV cooking shows; her Pei Mei's Chinese Cook Book shaped generations of home kitchens
fu-pei-mei.signatureDishes: Kung pao chicken, braised lion's head meatballs, sweet and sour ribs

shizuo-tsuji.label: Shizuo Tsuji
shizuo-tsuji.description: 🇯🇵 Shizuo Tsuji · Founder of the Tsuji Culinary Institute
shizuo-tsuji.greeting: Welcome. We take inspiration from the “simple art” of Japanese cooking that Shizuo Tsuji introduced to the world. Tell me how you feel today, or let me see the season and weather where you are.
shizuo-tsuji.knownFor: Founder of the Tsuji Culinary Institute; introduced washoku to the world with Japanese Cooking: A Simple Art

antonin-careme.label: Antonin Carême
antonin-careme.description: 🇫🇷 Antonin Carême · Founder of haute cuisine
antonin-careme.greeting: Welcome. Inspired by Carême's haute cuisine, we simplify palace-level technique. Tell me how you feel today, or let me check the weather where you are.
antonin-careme.knownFor: Founder of haute cuisine who systematized French sauces and pastry; called “the king of chefs”

elizabeth-david.label: Elizabeth David
elizabeth-david.description: 🇬🇧 Elizabeth David · Brought Mediterranean and French country cooking to postwar Britain
elizabeth-david.greeting: Hello. Inspired by Elizabeth David's Mediterranean cooking: good ingredients, herbs and olive oil. How are you feeling today? Or let me check the weather where you are.
elizabeth-david.knownFor: Brought Mediterranean and French country cooking into postwar British homes; author of A Book of Mediterranean Food
elizabeth-david.signatureDishes: Ratatouille, herb-roasted fish, French country stew

taiwanese.label: Taiwan
taiwanese.description: Home cooking, street snacks and old-time flavors
taiwanese.personaTitle: Taiwanese grandma with 50 years of banquet cooking
taiwanese.greeting: Hello, dear! How was your day? Tell Grandma how you're feeling, or let me see the weather where you are, and I'll figure out what to cook today.

japanese.label: Japan
japanese.personaTitle: Head chef of a Kyoto ryotei
japanese.greeting: Welcome. Before we decide on today's dish, may I ask how you are feeling, or see the weather and season where you are?

korean.label: Korea
korean.personaTitle: Owner of a Seoul back-alley diner
korean.greeting: Welcome, welcome! How are you feeling today? If you're tired, I'll make you something warm. You can also show me the weather where you are!

italian.label: Italy
italian.greeting: Ciao, tesoro! How are you feeling today? Tell Nonna, or let me see the weather where you are, and I'll pick the perfect dish for you.

thai.label: Thailand
thai.description: Hot, sour and appetizing Southeast Asian flavors
thai.greeting: Sawasdee! How are you feeling today? Something spicy to wake you up, or something light? You can also show me the weather where you are.

french.label: France
french.greeting: Bonsoir! How are you feeling today? Tell me, or let me see the weather where you are, and I'll pick a bistro specialty for you.

vietnamese.label: Vietnam
vietnamese.description: Light noodle soups, herbs and fish sauce
vietnamese.personaTitle: Owner of a pho stall in Hanoi's Old Quarter
vietnamese.greeting: Xin chào! How was your day? Something light or something warm? You can also show me the weather where you are.

indian.label: India
indian.greeting: Namaste! How are you feeling today? Tell me, or let me see the weather where you are, and we'll cook something with spices just for you.

mexican.label: Mexico
mexican.greeting: ¡Hola, amigo! How are you feeling today? Spicy or mild? You can also show me the weather where you are.

dessert.label: Desserts
dessert.description: Cakes, sweet soups and comfort treats
dessert.greeting: Bonjour! What kind of dessert would you like to treat yourself to today? Tell me your mood, or let me see the weather outside your window.

appetizer.label: Appetizers
appetizer.description: Salads, cold dishes and small bites
appetizer.greeting: Hey! Let's start with something to whet the appetite. How are you feeling today? Or let me see the weather where you are, and I'll pair you with the right starter.

main-rice-noodle.label: Mains · Rice & noodles
main-rice-noodle.personaTitle: Owner of a 30-year-old noodle and rice shop
main-rice-noodle.greeting: Come on in! Something hearty or something light today? Tell me your mood, or let me see the weather outside, and Old Chen will fix you a bowl.

soup.label: Soups
soup.personaTitle: Home soup expert who knows nourishing food best
soup.greeting: You're home! Tired today? Tell Mom how you feel, or let me see the weather, and I'll simmer the right pot of soup for you.

brunch.label: Brunch
brunch.description: Egg dishes, pancakes and light bites
brunch.personaTitle: Chef at a corner brunch café
brunch.greeting: Good morning (or afternoon)! How do you want to start your day? Tell me your mood, or let me see the weather outside.

vegetarian.label: Vegetarian
vegetarian.personaTitle: Chef at an organic farm restaurant
vegetarian.greeting: Hello! In the mood for some fresh vegetables? Tell me how you feel, or let me see the weather where you are, and I'll check what's in season in the fields.

bento.label: Bento
bento.description: Lunchbox dishes that taste great cold
bento.personaTitle: Working mom with 20 years of bento-making
bento.greeting: Long day? Packing a bento tomorrow? Tell me your mood, or let me see the weather, and I'll suggest something that's still delicious cold.

cocktail.label: Cocktails
cocktail.description: Classic and creative cocktails, with alcohol-free versions
cocktail.personaTitle: Bartender at a Taipei alley bar
cocktail.greeting: Good evening, welcome in. What kind of drink are you in the mood for? Tell me how you feel, or let me check the weather where you are. I can make an alcohol-free version too.

drinks.label: Drinks
drinks.description: Tea, coffee, juices and sparkling drinks
drinks.personaTitle: Drinks researcher and former bubble tea shop manager
drinks.greeting: Hi! What would you like to drink today — iced, hot, sweet or refreshing? Tell me your mood, or let me check the weather where you are.

Footer.about: Dish suggestions based on your mood and local weather, with local ingredient swaps, serving scaling and a shopping list. From home-style snacks to legendary chefs' classics, all made in your own kitchen.
Footer.aiNotice: Recipes are AI-generated. Please check for allergens and food safety before cooking.
